results.claim: Across the 24 pinned IOP modules, the relocation-aware parser returns exactly 746 export entries, versus 296 links visible to the earlier literal-zero-terminated parser.
Those 746 relocation-aware entries classify against the pinned Ghidra .text listing as 427 saved function entries, 162 unowned instruction addresses, and 157 undefined addresses.
Among 450 entries recovered only after synthetic relocation, 246 target saved function entries, 114 target unowned instructions, and 90 target undefined addresses.
The 0x1000 synthetic relocation base and listing classifications establish runtime address/callability.

claim_limits: Exact structural counts are supported. Synthetic relocation and listing classification do not establish runtime address, callability, symbol identity, or OS registration.
